title: RLHF quality telemetry and operator playbook
content:
Purpose:
This notebook collects metrics definitions, tracing conventions, and dashboard sketches for RLHF-driven output quality monitoring. Goal is an operator-friendly, compact signal set that detects regressions introduced by policy/model updates, identifies whether the issue is inference/policy/reranker/safety-filter related, and routes remediation steps to Applied ML or Runtime teams.

Context and motivation:
- RLHF stack introduces additional components beyond raw generation (policy scorer, reward model, reranker, human-review loop). We need observability that ties token-level latency/cost signals to higher-level quality regressions (human accept rate, safety hits, post-edit volumes).
- This doc is intentionally compact: pick ~12 signals (6 primary + 6 supporting) to surface on the operator dashboard and use traces to anchor investigations.

Primary metrics (definitions, collection frequency, and SLI intent):
1) human_accept_rate (H-accept): fraction of human-reviewed samples labeled accept within X window. Type: ratio; collection: event counter per review. SLI: rolling 7d p50 & 90. Alert if 7d p50 drops by >8% vs baseline.
2) safety_filter_trigger_rate: number of requests blocked/flagged by runtime safety filters per 1k requests. Type: rate; collection: increment at filter exit. Alert on sudden +3x spike in 1h or sustained +50% over 24h.
3) critic_score_drift: median reward-model score for sampled production prompts vs baseline sample. Type: distribution; collection: periodic batch scoring of sampled requests (sample-size configurable; default 2k/day). Alert on median shift > 0.25 or KL divergence > threshold.
4) post_edit_word_ratio: for items that go to human editors, ratio of words edited / words generated. Type: ratio; collection: human-review diff extractor. SLO: keep median < 0.10 for generative templates. Alert on median > 0.25.
5) preference-consistency: fraction of A/B paired reranks where top choice is stable across identical prompts. Collection: synthetic paired probes (run once per hour). Alert if consistency drops below 90% for 3 consecutive hours.
6) operator-reported-issue-rate: manual tickets opened flagged as quality-issue per 1k requests (operator UX telemetry). Useful to capture blindspots.

Supporting metrics (for drilldown):
- token_decoding_latency_p95 (ms) per model_variant
- reranker_latency_p95 (ms) by policy_variant
- policy_inference_time_p95 (ms)
- human-review-queue-depth and backlog_secs
- sample_rate_of_saved_prompts (to ensure we have data for offline scoring)
- top-10 prompt templates by H-accept delta (daily diff)

Metric collection notes and instrumentation hints:
- All metrics should carry the same core tags: model_id, model_version, rollout_id, tenant_id, policy_variant, prompt_template_id, region. This allows dashboard small-multiples and trace anchors.
- For critic_score_drift we do offline scoring of a reservoir-sampled set of production prompts; store baseline scores for the previous release to compute delta. Use monotonic counters for sample counts.
- Human-review diffs must be post-processed to remove PII before metric extraction (see security-and-compliance/PII-redaction-guidelines).

Trace design: key spans and attributes
- Root span: request.session.{session_id} (top-level request context). Tags: tenant_id, api_route, request_size, num_turns.
- policy.infer span(s): includes policy_variant, model_id, model_version, batch_size, input_tokens. Emit policy.score histogram.
- reranker.eval span: includes reranker_version, candidates_count, ranking_time_ms. Emit chosen_candidate_index tag.
- safety.filter span: decision=(ALLOW|FLAG|BLOCK), filter_set, matched_signal_count. If BLOCK, attach sample-id and short anonymized evidence blob.
- postprocess.human_review span (if present): editor_id (hashed), edit_word_count, edit_type_tags (sanitize, rewrite, hallucination_fix).
- persistence.store span: whether the sample was saved for offline eval.

Sampling and retention rules:
- Adaptive sampling: always sample 100% of safety.filter=BLOCK spans; sample 25% of policy.infer spans for high-traffic tenants, 100% for enterprise-tier tenants flagged in rollout.
- Store full trace payloads for 14 days hot tier, aggregated traces (top-level metrics) for 90 days. Operator playbook expects at least 7 days of full traces to debug.

Dashboard panels (operator home view; compact):
1) Top row: quick health KPIs (human_accept_rate 24h delta, critic_score_median delta, safety_filter_trigger_rate 1h spike indicator). Each KPI shows current value, 24h change, and small sparklines.
2) Latency & cost row: token_decoding_latency_p95 (per-model small multiples), reranker_latency_p95, token_per_response median.
3) Quality signals row: post_edit_word_ratio histogram, preference-consistency gauge, top-10 templates by H-accept drop.
4) Alert timeline: recent alerts affecting RLHF signals, linked to trace ids and sample replay snippets.
5) Trace explorer panel: mini list of traces with root cause tags (safety_hit, reranker_outlier, critic_downshift). Click opens full trace and saved prompt.
6) Sampling config widget: shows current sampling rate by tenant and allows temporary overrides (ops-only).

Operator playbook (what to do on an H-accept drop or critic_score drift):
- Triage (0-15m): check KPI row. Is safety_filter_trigger_rate spiking? If yes, open safety triage. If no, check reranker_latency_p95 and recent rollout_id.
- Trace anchoring (15-45m): open Trace explorer, filter for traces with critic_score in the bottom decile and postprocess.human_review present. Look at policy.infer spans for model_version differences. Save 20 examples to staging for Applied ML.
- Short-term mitigations (45-90m): consider throttling the new policy_variant rollout (via rollout_id) or fallback to previous model_version. If the issue is safety false positives, toggle safety-config-sandbox for a small canary (ops-only) and monitor.
- Longer-term (1d+): stash samples in offline eval bucket, run offline reward-model calibration, coordinate with Applied ML to retrain or adjust reranker weights.

Alert thresholds (starter suggestions, tuned per tenant):
- H-accept p50 drop: >=8% drop vs 14d baseline -> WARNING; >=15% -> PAGER.
- Safety filter spike: 3x in 1h -> WARNING; sustained 2x over 24h -> PAGER.
- Critic_score median delta: 0.25 -> WARNING; 0.5 -> PAGER.

Investigation queries (examples for metrics store - pseudo-SQL):
- "SELECT model_version, count(*) AS cnt, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY critic_score) AS median_score FROM production_events WHERE event_time > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY median_score;"
- "SELECT prompt_template_id, avg(post_edit_word_ratio) AS median_edit FROM human_edits WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY prompt_template_id ORDER BY median_edit DESC LIMIT 20;"
- "-- trace link query (for trace service)
SELECT trace_id FROM traces WHERE tag_rollout_id = 'canary-2026-02-15' AND span_name = 'safety.filter' AND decision = 'BLOCK' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;"

Notes to self / open questions:
- How do we best avoid confounding drift from input distribution shifts vs model/regressor instability? Need experiment: feed a fixed probe set daily + reservoir sample. (TODO: design sample size + retention)
- Is critic_score comparable between reward-model versions? Need calibration doc and versioned baselines. Add to linked_artifacts.
- Can we capture a compact representation of human edits (e.g., edit-type tags) without exposing PII? Reach out to security for a redaction rubric.

Small rollout checklist (ops-friendly):
- Enable enhanced tracing for rollout cohort (set sampling overrides)
- Turn on offline scoring for critic (sample capture true)
- Pin alert thresholds to pre-rollout baselines and create temporary guard rails (auto-sheriff)
- Assign Applied ML owner and Slack channel for 72h watch

Appendix: quick wireframes (text):
- KPI widget: left shows current human_accept_rate with colored band (green/yellow/red), center shows critic_score histogram overlay vs baseline, right shows safety_filter sparkline with event markers for BLOCKs.
- Trace explorer: collapsible list, each row: timestamp | tenant | model_version | primary-cause-tag | trace-id | sample-link.

Versioning and next steps:
- v0.1 (this doc): compact signal set + playbook (current).
- v0.2: implement sampling dashboard and wire up trace explorer links to saved prompts. Owner: Maya Singh.
- v1.0: add cross-tenant anomaly detection and auto-triage runbook. Dependencies: telemetry infra, trace retention policy update.
